description: Returns the string substring of value from zero-based code point position integer startIndex up to, but not including, endIndex. A negative index is 0 and an index past the end is the end of value. Omit endIndex to return through the end of value. If endIndex is less than startIndex, the two are swapped, and equal indexes return an empty string. Use slice to count from the end. The result is always string (a slice of anyURI is not an anyURI).

returns.description: Substring as string (not re-typed as the input data type).
